I lived in my own home back in 2020. I paid $75 for my power, $50 for water, $80 for internet and $750 a month in an older 3 bedroom 1 bath house by the bay with a backyard and old but huge garage.

I left and served in the army for 5 years amd opted to live in the barracks. So I went a good stretch where I wasnt looking at any utilities or rent. The housing payment just came directly out of my check for a few years.

Fast forward to now...im just speechless. 

I rent a TINY 2 bedroom 1 bath DUPLEX with no backyard, no garage, with leveling so off not a single interior door closes in the home and the bathtub cant drain. 

Rent is $1800 a month, my power isnt monthly but has to be paid daily or has a balance you keep filling up. I pay $250 minimum a month for power, $150 for water, and $150 for internet. 

And I live alone. No kids, no partner, just my tiny dog and 1 cat.

Heres the kicker.....my old house is half a mile from my old one. No change of state, I didnt move to a city. This is how much it has changed in 5 amd a half years and it makes me sick. 

Im now on disability through the VA and their 100% rating was BARELY enough to cover this in my state. Now with groceries, gas amd rent all goimg up I simply cant afford it anymore and will be living in my vehicle come August. 

And these data centers are only going to make everything skyrocket further.
